correctness.rationale: Itô formula gives the exact almost-sure growth objective. SPD verified by leading principal minors 2,3,1 gives strict concavity, so KKT conditions suffice. The two-coordinate optimizer is a clipped monotone rational function, excluding re-entry. Four explicit three-coordinate branches satisfy exact active/inactive KKT equations over an exhaustive partition of every v>0, and agree at all boundaries. The final branch has its unique positive growth root at 5+3sqrt(3), which is later than habitat exit at 5. Independent exact checker validates symbolic identities and 150 rational active-set comparisons. Fixed-share and Brownian assumptions explicitly delimit the theorem.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Schreiber analyzes density-regulated evolutionary stable dispersal choices, whereas the present theorem compares fixed time-independent allocations maximizing a low-density scalar log-growth functional; environmental covariance shape is fixed while a single amplitude varies. originality.rationale: The specific exact statement is a sharply minimal three-habitat entry-then-exit support trajectory for the fixed low-density stochastic growth objective, with four explicitly solved phases and persistent regional rescue despite negative isolated exponents. Compared with the relevant ecological source and mathematically dominating mean-variance optimization sources, this exact statement was not located in the materially inspected portions. General KKT/critical-line techniques and objective are explicitly acknowledged as known. Residual mathematical priority risk is recorded; no independent novelty certification is claimed.

value.rationale: Ecological risk diversification can open and subsequently close a habitat while a regional population still has positive low-density log-growth, even when every individual habitat would decline. Sharp two-versus-three habitat separation and an explicit four-phase support trajectory are structural and transferable benchmarks for stochastic spatial growth, rather than a parameter-rounding curiosity. This is not an empirical conservation recommendation.
